summary: PLAT-103 shipped via mono PR #1 (merged, CI and CD green): validateApp now throws when app.owner is missing or blank; shared-contracts bumped to 2.0.0 (breaking); core-shell (platform), sub-route-billing (payments) and sub-route-reports (insights) pass owner. Assumptions: (1) shared-contracts is inlined at build time, so 'adopting the new release' means the in-PR code change, not a registry bump; (2) owner values are hardcoded literals matching each app's package.json team field; (3) sub-route-reports also calls validateApp and was not listed, so it was included to keep it starting up; (4) PLAT-103-2/3 had to land in the same PR as PLAT-103-1 because the lib is inlined. PLAT-103-4 NOT DONE: libs-platform-kit never calls validateApp and has no dependency on @mfe/shared-contracts, which is not published to the registry, so there is nothing to pass owner to; no change made there. Flagging for the ticket owner to confirm whether that sub-task should be closed as not applicable.
